description: This file defines the LabelMaker class, which facilitates creating and rendering text labels in an OpenGL ES environment for Android. It manages label textures, including creating bitmaps, drawing text, handling OpenGL texture setup, and rendering labels efficiently using texture atlases.

classes.name: LabelMaker
classes.description: A class that creates and manages text labels as textures for rendering with OpenGL ES, supporting adding, measuring, and drawing labels efficiently.

methods.name: LabelMaker
methods.description: Constructor initializing label maker with specified color mode, strike width, and height.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL texture for label rendering, creating a texture ID and setting texture parameters.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Deletes the OpenGL texture associated with the label maker, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: beginAdding
methods.description: Prepares the label maker to add new labels, creating a bitmap and clearing previous labels.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a label with specified text and paint; can include a background drawable.

methods.name: endAdding
methods.description: Finalizes label addition by uploading the bitmap as a texture to OpenGL.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width in pixels of a specified label.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height in pixels of a specified label.

methods.name: getBaseline
methods.description: Returns the baseline position in pixels of a specified label.

methods.name: beginDrawing
methods.description: Sets up OpenGL state for efficient label drawing in a scene.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws a label at a specific (x, y) position in pixels.

methods.name: endDrawing
methods.description: Restores OpenGL state after label drawing.
